# SoundTouch 2.3.3

Source archive https://www.surina.net/soundtouch/soundtouch-2.3.3.tar.gz

Archive SHA-256 `43b23dfac2f64a3aff55d64be096ffc7b73842c3f5665caff44975633a975a99`.

This directory contains the unmodified tempo-processing sources and public headers needed by SeedlessDS. BPM detection, command-line utilities and upstream project files are omitted. CMakeLists.txt is the local static-library integration, using floating-point samples.
